name: Expanded Mantle
body:
Prerequisite(s): Dire mantle class feature

Benefit(s): The storage capacity of your dire mantle increases by 2. This feat may only be chosen once.

Normal: A dire mantle’s storage capacity is equal to the possessor’s Charisma modifier.
